- Grade F (below 40 marks) carries 0 grade points and is a fail grade.
- SGPA is the credit-weighted average of grade points in a semester. CGPA is the credit-weighted

- A minimum CGPA of 5.0 is required for the award of the degree.

- Postgraduate students may borrow 6 books at a time for 21 days.

- Reference books, journals and past question papers cannot be issued and must be used inside

Official amendment
 - Subject: Amendment to Clauses 4.2 and 6.1 of the Examination and Assessment Rules dated 1

- With the approval of the Academic Council at its meeting on 28 May 2025, the following
amendments are made with effect from 1 July 2025.

1. Moderation and grace marks

maximum marks.

of the Moderation Committee.
- Grace marks of up to 2 marks may be given to a student only to convert a fail into a pass, and only
in 1 course per semester.

2. Confidentiality
 - Moderation sheets are confidential and must not be shared with students.
- Faculty members must not discuss moderation decisions or grace marks with students.
- Moderation records are retained for 5 years in the office of the Controller of Examinations.

2. Leave procedure and monitoring
 - A leave application must be submitted through the student portal within 5 days of returning to
class.
- Medical leave must be supported by a certificate from a registered medical practitioner.
- Classes missed on approved on-duty leave are counted as present, subject to a cap of 10% of the
classes conducted in the course.
- The student portal sends an automatic warning email when a student's attendance in any course
falls below 80%.
- This policy shall be reviewed every 2 years.

- Clause 3.2. No student is allowed to enter after 30 minutes from the start of the examination, and
no student may leave during the first hour.

2. Grading and CGPA
 - Grade O (90 to 100 marks) carries 10 grade points. Grade A+ (80 to 89 marks) carries 9 grade
points. Grade A (70 to 79 marks) carries 8 grade points.
- Grade B (60 to 69 marks) carries 7 grade points. Grade C (50 to 59 marks) carries 6 grade points.
Grade D (40 to 49 marks) carries 5 grade points.
- Grade F (below 40 marks) carries 0 grade points and is a fail grade.
- SGPA is the credit-weighted average of grade points in a semester. CGPA is the credit-weighted
average of grade points over all completed semesters.
- A minimum CGPA of 5.0 is required for the award of the degree.

Discretionary waiver pool
 - The discretionary fee waiver pool for the academic year 2025-26 is Rs. 25,00,000.
- The Principal may approve a waiver of up to Rs. 50,000 per student without reference to a
committee. Larger waivers need the approval of the Governing Council.
- This pool is not advertised publicly and the list of recipients is confidential.
- Waivers from this pool are granted only after the Scholarship Committee has confirmed that the
student does not qualify for any published scholarship.

Scholarship Guidelines

1. Types of scholarships
 - Merit Scholarship: students in the top 5% of their programme by CGPA, with a minimum CGPA of
8.5, receive a waiver of 50% of tuition fees.
- Need-based Scholarship: students whose family annual income is below Rs. 4,00,000 receive a
waiver of 30% of tuition fees.
- Sports Scholarship: students who have represented their state or country at an official
championship receive a waiver of 25% of tuition fees.
- A student may hold only one scholarship at a time. Waivers cannot be combined.
- Applications for all scholarships must be submitted on the scholarship portal by 31 August each
year.

2025. From that date the 2023 policy is no longer in force.

may be condoned by the Dean of Academics on submission of a valid medical or emergency
document.

- Attendance below 65% cannot be condoned and the student must repeat the course.

Department.
